title: Neptune to Virgo: One Line Blank
old_caption: Nobody matches a forty-point list, and that's not a flaw in them. Keep what truly matters (kind, honest, shows up) and leave a little room to be surprised.

title: Neptune to Libra: Just the Trailer
old_caption:
Libra fell for the coat, the playlist and all six photos. Gorgeous trailer. The film is called a first date.
Tag the friend who's in love with a profile right now.

title: Neptune to Scorpio: The Tinted Lenses
old_caption: Calling late replies and cancelled plans mysterious is easy when you really like someone. Look at how they treat you, not the mystery. You deserve someone clear.

title: Neptune to Sagittarius: Coffee, Not a Flight
old_caption:
One hour at a festival and Sag is already at the departures board. Neptune approves of the meet-cute. The next scene is just a coffee.
Who in your life would book the flight?

title: Neptune to Capricorn: Permission to Daydream
old_caption:
You can plan your whole life and still forget to feel it. Letting yourself want something isn't off-schedule.
This is your permission to daydream a little.

title: Neptune to Aquarius: Caught Watching the Rom-Com
old_caption:
"I don't do romance. It was research." Paused on the airport scene, though.
Which sign secretly rewatches the same love story every winter?

title: Neptune to Pisces: The Movie in Your Head
old_caption:
Three sweet texts and a whole future in your head. Pisces, the daydream is lovely, but the real one replies, makes plans and shows up on a rainy Tuesday.
Stay for the ending.

title: Pluto to Aries: Over It by Friday
old_caption:
Aries tried to speedrun a breakup with a stopwatch, and Pluto crashed through the ceiling about it.
A planet that takes 248 years to lap the Sun says take your time. Who's your friend who's "totally over it" by lunch?

title: Pluto to Taurus: The Mug You Kept
old_caption:
Keeping their mug because it's comfy is a very human thing to do.
Letting go isn't losing, it's making room. Keep one kind memory if you like, and let the rest go slowly, at your own pace.

title: Pluto to Gemini: Seventeen Drafts of Closure
old_caption:
Draft one was a paragraph. Draft four was a poem. Draft five was a four-minute voice note.
Pluto's verdict: closure is something you give yourself. How many drafts are you on?
